# A-R5 — KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER: the S215–S217 frontier — #581 integrity CLOSED (15/16 post-images exact, `cda66364` = the true post-image), R23/R24/R25 re-census at `14c4bf4e` (all three still open), the forgotten work COMPLETED (R23 Collections algorithmic face + R24 StringBuilder mutation family + the R25 4×4 declared≠runtime receiver matrix, 14/14), and one new finding (R27: the `resolve_method_proto_uncached` `"()V"` constant) — patch sha16 `35e0c189b6d21746`, base `14c4bf4e`

> **Purpose:** Continue the review work and close the wave A-R4 left open. A-R1 (#576) transferred §30/§32/§37/§39/§44; A-R2 (#578) §15/§27/§40/§88/§91; A-R3 (#579/#580) §28/§31/§33–§36/§38/§41 and §89/§87/§90; A-R4 (#581) the last five orphan families (§7 E · §10 H · §5 C · §4 B · §23 U) with findings R23–R25. This round: (1) the #581 integrity request is **ANSWERED with byte-level evidence** (the main coder's two findings confirmed, confirmation posted there); (2) the A-R lane's own fix-PENDING findings are **re-censused at the current main** — R23/R24/R25 all still open; (3) **the forgotten work is now completed**: the R23 and R24 fixes are IMPLEMENTED and gated, and the R25 demanded deliverable (the 4 invoke kinds × 4 declared-receiver shapes matrix) is MATERIALIZED as an executable probe — **14/14 rows PASS** — which immediately surfaced **R27**, a real dispatch-path defect, fixed in the same wave; (4) the A-R4 features are verified INTACT on the post-GP-582-wave main, and the GP-INT-013 × A-R4 REM_DOUBLE_2ADDR interplay is proven CONSISTENT (the shared `ARITH_WIDE_2ADDR_CASE` macro carries the `bits_l2d` + `fmod` law into the 2ADDR face; the A-R4 probe re-runs **5/5** on the patched tree).

**Base commit reviewed + patched:** `14c4bf4e` (current `origin/main`, S217 HEAD; `git ls-remote`-verified 2026-11-12 at posting time).

**Method:** (1) #581 comment-diff reconstruction on a pristine `34927880` worktree (apply-check, post-image blob audit, landed-content verbatim check); (2) A-R-findings re-census at `14c4bf4e` (the exact K-4 greps re-run); (3) A-R4-feature grep battery on `14c4bf4e`; (4) line-cited review of the two fix sites + the dispatch path the R25 probe exercises; (5) implementation + full local gate battery (build green `make -j1`, `make test` 4/4, `mwr_opcode_probe` 5/5, `r25_matrix` 14/14); (6) patch transfer in this issue's comments per K-2.

---

## 1. The #581 integrity closure (summary — full evidence on #581)

- Posted parts 1+2 re-assembled: apply-CLEAN rc=0 on pristine `34927880`, 16 files +2,618/−11 (as advertised); **15/16 post-image blob hashes EXACT**; the one mismatch (`dalvik_engine.cpp`) yields `cda66364f4c4ac025f5d8560ea988a613ba1d418` — **byte-identical to the main coder's observed value**. Confirmed from the lane side: the posted diff is the delivery; the declared `sha16 8bdf0881e0d39bcd`/index `4e448918` were pre-final-edit mintings (the pre-hash state was never committed — unrecoverable; the diff CONTENT is the invariant).
- **All 207 posted added lines exist verbatim in the landed `b24e1765`**; 3/4 removed lines confirmed gone (the 4th is a common expression legitimately duplicated by the patch's own new MOVE_WIDE_16 arm).

## 2. The A-R findings re-census at `14c4bf4e` (reasoning, not assertion — every grep re-run)

| Finding | State at `14c4bf4e` | Evidence (exact grep) |
|---|---|---|
| R23 Collections algorithmic face | **still open** | `reverse/shuffle/swap/rotate/nCopies/binarySearch/frequency/disjoint` → `method == "…"` engine=0 / shadows=0 for every row |
| R24 StringBuilder mutation family | **still open** | `method == "setLength"` / `"deleteCharAt"` / `"reverse"` → 0 hits engine+shadows; the boundary comment still stands |
| R25 C3 4×4 matrix | **still open** | `grep -rln "declared receiver" tests fixtures scripts` → 0 |
| A-R4 landed features | **INTACT** | `JNI-PENDING` 1 · `__random_state__` 8 · `MOVE_WIDE_16` 1 · `REM_DOUBLE_2ADDR` 1 · `contentDescription` 1 · `take_pending_jni_exception` 1 — all present on `14c4bf4e` |
| GP-INT-013 × A-R4 interplay | **CONSISTENT** | GP-582's `ARITH_WIDE_2ADDR` macro rewrite carries `bits_l2d` decode + `fmod` NaN law into rem-double/2addr automatically (same macro); `mwr_opcode_probe` **5/5** re-run on the patched tree |

## 3. Findings

Status vocabulary per K-6. Numbering continues A-R4's R26 (the reconciliation row).

### R27 — FAMILY A9/F-280 chain: `resolve_method_proto_uncached`'s merged-table fallback answers the CONSTANT `"()V"` while the true descriptor sits unused in the class-info tables (`P1`, FIXED IN THIS WAVE)

**Where.** `miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp`, `resolve_method_proto_uncached` fallback (raw-DEX path is fine — the merged-table arm at the `fallback:` label). Pre-fix, when `per_dex_raw_data_` has no raw bytes for the report (synthetic reports, harness worlds, any proto_ids-less report), the arm read `method_ids[method_idx].proto_idx`, gave up ("multi-DEX merging shifts indices"), and returned `"()V"` — **never consulting `dex_report_->classes` through `class_info_index_`, where every method's real descriptor is already materialized**.

**Consequence (the R25 matrix's first-row evidence).** The `"()V"` constant leaked into every descriptor-sensitive decision. The F-280 exact-(name, proto) block inside `try_recursive_invoke` compared `"()V"` against the receiver method's real `"()I"`, declared NO local exact match, ran its super-walk, and the walk let an ANCESTOR's lenient-selected same-name body execute — **the receiver class's own declaration never dispatched**: `new-instance LSub;` + `invoke-virtual LSub.m` (m()I, override of LBase.m) answered **1, the BASE body** — the ART-law violation §5 C3 demanded the matrix surface. After the fix the same rows answer the override (2) and the full matrix is 14/14.

**Law (Tier 1).** JVMS 5.4.3.4 resolution keys on (class, name, proto); ART resolves the proto from the DEX method_ids/proto_ids — in a merged-report world the class-info method table IS the proto authority. Best-available fallback: first same-name non-empty descriptor in the declared class's direct+virtual methods (overload ambiguity documented; strictly more accurate than the constant; the raw-DEX path is untouched so real-APK proto_ids resolution is byte-identical).

**Verify (K-4).**
```
make r25_matrix          # 14/14 PASS — rows v_declared_super/s_declared_* are the R27 discriminators
grep -n "CLASS-INFO PROTO" miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp   # the fix, with the full root-cause comment
# pre-fix face (recorded): v_declared_super expected 2, got 1 (the LBase body)
```

**Fix location.** Implemented in this wave — the `fallback:` arm of `resolve_method_proto_uncached` (see the patch part 1: `resolve_method_proto_uncached`, the `CLASS-INFO PROTO FALLBACK LAW` comment).

### R28 — FAMILY A9: the F-280 super-walk lets an ANCESTOR's lenient-selected body outrank the receiver's own same-name declaration when NO exact (name, proto) exists anywhere in the chain (`P2`, residual after R27)

**Where.** The F-280 block inside `try_recursive_invoke` (`dalvik_engine.cpp`, the `local_exact` super-walk arm). Its walk accepts `try_recursive_invoke_on_super` success — but the ancestor's own dispatch can succeed LENIENTLY (name-only, its own F-280 walk failing, its lenient selection executing a same-name body). ART law: resolution keys on (name, proto) — a lenient ancestor body must never outrank the receiver class's own same-name declaration.

**Consequence at HEAD.** With R27 fixed, this face shrinks to proto_idx-out-of-range / corrupt-proto reports (the descriptor can no longer degrade to `"()V"` while the class-info table is present). The R25 probe rows all PASS now; the face is recorded as the residual with its exact repro shape (the pre-fix matrix run: every legal cell answered the base body). Follow-up lever (not landed — the dispatch core is shared territory with the landing lanes and the 6-pin corpus is the gate): exact-proto-only acceptance in the F-280 walk via a strict flag on `try_recursive_invoke_on_super`.

**Verify (K-4).**
```
grep -n "No ancestor declares the exact (name, proto) either" miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp
# the walk-FAIL path already continues to the receiver's OWN lenient selection —
# the residual is only the walk-SUCCESS-via-lenient-ancestor face
```

### R29 — FAMILY C3 observational faces: invoke-direct/super on a receiver that is NOT an instance of the resolved class executes the body instead of the ART ICPE/ICCE (`P3`, recorded boundary)

The R25 matrix's two observational cells (recorded, not gated): `o_direct_subclass_method_on_super_recv` (invoke-direct LPrivSub.pm on an LPriv receiver) answers **8** (the subclass body); `o_super_unrelated_declared` (invoke-super LPriv.pm on an LBase receiver) answers **7** (the declared body). ART prescribes ICPE/ICCE for both. Recorded so the boundary is visible; a fix is optional and low-priority (no live consumer observed).

## 4. The completed forgotten work — what the patch delivers (K-2)

| Item | Content | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| R23 fix | the Collections ALGORITHMIC static face beside the F-606 sort arm in `CollectionShadow::dispatch` — `reverse` · `shuffle` (deterministic fixed-seed splitmix64, the runtime's determinism law documented in-code) · `swap` (AIOBE law) · `rotate` · `fill` (List AND `T[]` overloads) · `copy` ("Source does not fit in dest" IOOBE law) · `nCopies` (IAE n<0, 4096 honesty cap) · `addAll(Collection, T...)` (varargs-array read through the heap array-element getters) · `min`/`max` (NoSuchElementException empty, ClassCastException incomparable) · `binarySearch` (insertion-point negative law) · `frequency` · `disjoint` · `replaceAll` · `indexOfSubList`/`lastIndexOfSubList` (empty-target 0/size law) — all over the four parallel stores + `view_elements`, with the F-606 dual-store heap `array[i]` re-sync and the F-NEW-238/236d equality + K14 dex-comparator machinery reused | build green; compile-level gate (the APK battery stays the main coder's env, same protocol as A-R3/A-R4) |
| R24 fix | the AbstractStringBuilder MUTATION family in the SB block — `setLength` (truncate/zero-fill; negative → SIOOBE) · `setCharAt` · `insert` · `deleteCharAt` · `delete` (clamp + start>end law) · `reverse` (byte-level documented approximation) · `replace` · `substring` · `capacity` (informational min-capacity face) · `ensureCapacity`/`trimToSize` (content-neutral) — the `setLength(0)` per-frame reset idiom no longer accumulates | build green; compile-level gate |
